evidence.note: Blue accent marks only focus: section eyebrow, active nav tab, current timeline marker 1 and the lock badge; body text and title stay neutral ink.
Blue encodes agent runs (matched by the 'Agent Run' legend), black encodes coordinators (legend), completed timeline markers turn grey while the current one stays blue.
Blue agent dot/flag and a blue 'scorer' pass pill mark the agent and its state; the single red X marks the scorer rejecting, a failure state.
Red appears only on 'Sacrificed' agent dots, declared in the legend as the loss role; no red text or headings anywhere.
Insight card uses neutral ink with no role colour applied decoratively.

rationale: Across all steps blue is confined to focus/current state and the agent series, black to coordinators, and red only to loss/failure (sacrificed runs, scorer rejection), each declared by a legend or context. No role colour is used as decoration or for emphasis text, and the colours sit together without clash. This matches the pass descriptor.
